moments.author: Jemele Hill
moments.quote: I really hope ESPN lays me off… No need to draw this out.
moments.why: A sarcastic jab at layoff rumors that blew up amid misinformation, sparking a wave of bots and AI sites misreporting her status.

moments.author: Jemele Hill
moments.quote: I clearly responded with sarcasm… now there are several AI‑generated/aggregated websites reporting that I resigned.
moments.why: Her follow-up critique on how sarcasm was stripped and turned into fake news went viral, highlighting media breakdown and AI problems.

moments.author: Kevin Ingram
moments.quote: An honor to be part of Mark Howard’s induction into the Tennessee Radio Hall of Fame.
moments.why: Niche but trending within sports business circles—radio legends nostalgic for older male audiences sparked lively conversation.

moments.author: SEC Mike
moments.quote: They were thinking about firing me. This might be worse than Urban Meyer to the Jags.
moments.why: A funny, tense insider comment about his pre‑SEC Network scare resonated with audiences navigating high‑stakes sports media.

moments.author: Sydney Supple
moments.quote: Adidas put together one of the most impressive displays… Well done Adidas.
moments.why: A shout‑out to cultural branding that caught attention from guys interested in ads, style, and sports culture.
